series_title: Khatu Shyam ji ki Amar Katha
series_title_hi: खाटू श्याम जी की अमर कथा
playlist: Khatu Shyam ji ki Amar Katha
source: Lok katha (Khatu Shyam parampara) ke anusar; Barbarik ka prasang Skanda Purana (Kaumarika Khand) ki parampara mein bhi milta hai
approval_note: Owner reviews the pilot (E:\SK\movie-pilot\part-1.mp4) first. Until "approved" is true the movie job renders each part and parks it for review (media Worker link + artifact) but uploads nothing.

parts.title: Barbarik ka Janm aur Vachan
parts.synopsis: Ghatotkach aur Maa Morvi ke putra Barbarik, maa se yudh-kala, tapasya aur teen baan (manyata: Shiv ji ka vardan), 'haare ka sahara' banne ka vachan, Kurukshetra ki or prasthan; raaste mein ek Brahmin.

parts.title: Brahmin ki Pariksha
parts.synopsis: Brahmin vesh mein Shri Krishna, 'ek hi baan kaafi hai', peepal ke patton ki pariksha, pair ke neeche chhupa patta, Krishna samajh gaye ki vachan ke kaaran Barbarik haarne wale Kauravon ka saath denge, daan ka vachan, 'mujhe tumhara sheesh chahiye'.

parts.title: Sheesh ka Daan
parts.synopsis: Asli roop ki maang, Shri Krishna ka darshan, ranbhoomi ki pooja ke liye veer ka sheesh, yudh dekhne ki ichchha, Phalgun Shukla Dwadashi ko sheesh daan (parampara), sheesh ko pahadi par sthapit kiya, atharah din ka yudh.

parts.title: Shyam Naam ka Vardan
parts.synopsis: Vijay ke shrey ka vivaad, sheesh ka uttar (sirf Sudarshan chakra dikha), vardan: Kalyug mein mere naam Shyam se pooje jaoge, Khatu mein sheesh ka prakat hona (lok katha: gaay ka doodh), Shyam Kund, mandir, aaj Dev Uthani Ekadashi par Janmotsav.

facts.claim: Barbarik Ghatotkach aur Maurvi (Morvi) ke putra aur Bheem ke pautra the
Kuch kathaon mein maata ka naam Ahilavati milta hai
Maa ne hi Barbarik ko yudh-kala sikhayi
Teen ajeya baan: manyata Shiv ji ka vardan; kuch kathaon mein Devi/Bhagwati ka
Maa ko vachan: haarne wale paksh ka saath ('haare ka sahara')
Brahmin vesh mein Krishna ne peepal ke saare patte ek baan se chhedne ko kaha; ek patta pair ke neeche chhupaya; baan pair ke paas ghoomne laga
Krishna ne sheesh daan maanga; Barbarik ne asli roop dekhne aur poora yudh dekhne ki ichchha rakhi
Sheesh ko Kurukshetra ke paas ek oonchi pahadi par rakha gaya
Yudh ke baad shrey ka vivaad; sheesh ne kaha use sirf Sudarshan chakra dikha
Vardan: mere naam Shyam se pooje jaoge (Kalyug), Khatu mein prakat hone se Khatu Shyam
Lok katha: ek gaay ek sthan par doodh bahati thi; wahan khudai mein sheesh mila (Shyam Kund); Roop Singh Chauhan ne swapn ke baad mandir banwaya
Khatu Shyam Janmotsav Kartik Shukla (Dev Uthani) Ekadashi par, 2026 mein 20 Nov
